days.title: Day 1 — Arrive in Manhattan
days.subtitle: Fri Oct 9 • Lotte New York Palace • Le Bernardin dinner
days.tip: Request the Tower section at check-in — views over St. Patrick's Cathedral and midtown are worth asking for. Book Le Bernardin 3–4 weeks ahead; it fills fast and does not take walk-ins.

stops.name: Check In — Lotte New York Palace
stops.notes: 455 Madison Ave, New York • request Tower section • views over St. Patrick's Cathedral • (212) 888-7000

stops.name: Afternoon Walk — Rockefeller Center
stops.notes: Leisurely orientation • no agenda • stroll Madison Ave or Rockefeller Center promenade • decompress after travel

stops.name: Le Bernardin
stops.notes: 155 W 51st St • ⭐⭐⭐ Michelin • four-course prix-fixe • $185–$220/person before wine • business casual • (212) 554-1515

days.title: Day 2 — MoMA, Broadway & The Modern
days.subtitle: Sat Oct 10 • Museum of Modern Art • The Modern lunch • The Great Gatsby
days.tip: Pre-order Broadway drinks online to skip the bar line at intermission. The Modern's bar room is less formal than the dining room — great if you couldn't book the main room far enough ahead.

stops.name: Museum of Modern Art (MoMA)
stops.notes: 11 W 53rd St • 90 min to 2 hrs • Matisse & Picasso galleries, sculpture garden, photography floor • elevator throughout • moma.org

stops.name: The Modern
stops.notes: 9 W 53rd St (inside MoMA) • ⭐ Michelin • 3-course prix-fixe overlooks sculpture garden • $85–$110/person before wine • (212) 333-1220

stops.name: Broadway — The Great Gatsby
stops.notes: Broadway Theatre • 1681 Broadway • orchestra center rows D–L or front mezzanine center • arrive 20 min early

stops.name: Trouble's Trust — Hotel Bar
stops.notes: Lotte New York Palace cocktail bar • comfortable and uncrowded late on a weeknight • light bites available

days.title: Day 3 — Central Park & Scarpetta
days.subtitle: Sun Oct 11 • Central Park peak fall color • Fifth Ave • Italian dinner
days.tip: Mid-to-late October is peak color in Central Park — the Mall, the Pond, and Bow Bridge are the highlights. A carriage at the 59th St entrance does the standard loop in about 45 minutes.

stops.name: Central Park — Grand Army Plaza
stops.notes: 59th St / Grand Army Plaza entrance • Bow Bridge & the Pond at peak fall color • carriage ride or flat walk toward Bethesda Fountain

stops.name: Fifth Ave & Madison Ave
stops.notes: Afternoon open by design • browse Fifth Ave or Madison Ave boutiques at your pace

stops.name: The Whitby Hotel — Afternoon Tea
stops.notes: 18 W 56th St • beautifully designed interior • afternoon tea served daily • excellent pre-dinner option

stops.name: Scarpetta
stops.notes: 88 Madison Ave • signature spaghetti with tomato & basil • duck and foie gras ravioli • branzino • $75–$110/person before wine • (212) 691-0555

days.title: Day 4 — Drive North: Hudson Valley
days.subtitle: Mon Oct 12 • Poughkeepsie • Walkway Over the Hudson • Wildflower Farms
days.tip: Leave Manhattan by 9:00–9:30 AM to clear midtown before traffic builds. The Walkway elevator is on the Poughkeepsie side — no stairs required.

stops.name: Depart NYC — Pick Up Rental Car
stops.notes: Check out of Lotte New York Palace • head north on Henry Hudson Pkwy to Taconic State Pkwy • ~1.5–2 hrs to Poughkeepsie

stops.name: Walkway Over the Hudson
stops.notes: 61 Parker Ave, Poughkeepsie • 212 ft above the Hudson River • fully paved & level • 2.6 miles round trip (turn back any time) • panoramic fall color • free • elevator access

stops.name: The River Station — Lunch
stops.notes: 1 Water St, Poughkeepsie • casual Hudson River views • 5 min from Walkway parking

stops.name: Wildflower Farms — Check In
stops.notes: 2702 Main St, Gardiner, NY • farmhouse cottages at foot of Shawangunks • request mountain-view cottage • spa, heated pool, farm paths • (855) 472-3188

stops.name: Clay at Wildflower Farms — Dinner
stops.notes: On property • farm-to-table • wood-roasted dishes exceptional • $70–$95/person before wine • notify at check-in

days.title: Day 5 — Minnewaska & Farm Rest
days.subtitle: Tue Oct 13 • Lake Minnewaska • Wildflower Farms afternoon • Clay dinner
days.tip: Arrive at Minnewaska by 9:30 AM on weekends — the parking lot fills by mid-morning. Bring layers; at ridge elevation the temperature runs 5–10°F cooler than the valley.

stops.name: Minnewaska State Park Preserve
stops.notes: Route 44-55, Kerhonkson • $10 parking • carriage road loop ~2.5 miles around Lake Minnewaska • wide compacted gravel • fall color reflecting on the sky lake • extraordinary in October

stops.name: Lunch — New Paltz or On Property
stops.notes: New Paltz Main St, 10 min away • Duo Bistro or Rock and Rye Tavern • or return to Clay at Wildflower Farms for a lighter lunch

stops.name: Wildflower Farms — Spa & Afternoon
stops.notes: Walk the farm paths • use the spa • sit on your cottage porch with mountain views • rest afternoon by design

stops.name: Mohonk Preserve — Optional Walk
stops.notes: Adjacent to Minnewaska • visitor center & shorter loop trails for a late-afternoon second outing

stops.name: Clay at Wildflower Farms — Dinner
stops.notes: Second evening • try different dishes • menu rotates • kitchen creative enough to justify two visits

days.title: Day 6 — Catskills & Kingston
days.subtitle: Wed Oct 14 • Kaaterskill Falls • Mountain Top Arboretum • Hotel Kinsley
days.tip: The elevation at Mountain Top Arboretum (2,500 ft) means fall color there runs 1–2 weeks ahead of the valley. If timing the trip for peak color, this may be your most vibrant stop.

stops.name: Depart Wildflower Farms
stops.notes: Check out • drive north into the Catskills • ~50 miles, 1 hour to Kaaterskill

stops.name: Kaaterskill Falls
stops.notes: Laurel House Rd parking, Haines Falls • tallest waterfall in NY • short flat walk from parking (<0.5 mi) • hemlock gorge in full color • wear grip shoes • free • allow 45–60 min

stops.name: Mountain Top Arboretum
stops.notes: 4 Maude Adams Rd, Tannersville • 2,500 ft elevation • 178 acres • flat wide trails • hemlock groves, native meadows, wetland boardwalk • free admission • allow 45–60 min

stops.name: The Prospect Restaurant
stops.notes: 5471 Main St, Tannersville • 3 min from arboretum • casual option before driving to Kingston

stops.name: Hotel Kinsley — Check In
stops.notes: 301 Wall St, Kingston, NY • historic Uptown Stockade District • boutique hotel • (845) 768-3620

stops.name: Dinner — Stockade District
stops.notes: Walk from hotel: Ca' Mea (135 Fair St, rustic Italian BYOB, one of Kingston's best) • Parish (5 Broadway, seasonal American, great cocktails) • or Hotel Kinsley restaurant on site

days.title: Day 7 — Bethel Woods, Hudson & Home
days.subtitle: Thu Oct 15 • Museum at Bethel Woods • feast & floret lunch • return to NYC
days.tip: Leave Hudson by 2:00–2:30 PM to beat the late-afternoon Taconic traffic. Hudson to Midtown is about 2 to 2.5 hours in normal conditions — depart on time.

stops.name: Depart Kingston — Drive to Bethel
stops.notes: Check out of Hotel Kinsley • drive west through Sullivan County • ~45 miles, 55 min to Bethel Woods

stops.name: Museum at Bethel Woods
stops.notes: 200 Hurd Rd, Bethel, NY • original 1969 Woodstock site • outstanding museum on '60s cultural history • open 10 AM–5 PM • $20 admission • allow 90 min–2 hrs • walk the path to the original concert field

stops.name: Drive to Hudson, NY
stops.notes: ~55 miles, 1 hr 10 min east on NY-17 to I-87 north

stops.name: feast & floret
stops.notes: 13 S 3rd St, Hudson, NY • open-fire kitchen • exceptional pasta • escarole salad, mushroom pasta, braised short rib over polenta • $45–$65/person lunch • browse Warren St antiques after

stops.name: Return to New York City
stops.notes: Hudson to Midtown ~115 miles, 2–2.5 hrs • depart by 2:00–2:30 PM to avoid Taconic traffic • south on I-87 to Henry Hudson Pkwy
